name: Short video publishing

does: Queues short videos the organization made, each with a provenance record: the file's hash, what made it, whether it is synthetic, and the fresh public claims it rests on
Checks every video before it is queued: length limit, disclosure label on synthetic media, links on the allowlist, sources that are fresh public claims
Publishes approved videos to the configured channel account, within a daily and a weekly cap
Reads each video back to confirm it is live with the same provenance hash, and reads views to measure itself
does_not: Publish synthetic media without a visible disclosure label, or strip provenance from a video
Impersonate a person, clone a real person's voice or face, or post as one
Buy views, subscribers or engagement, or use fake accounts
Publish a video whose sources are not fresh public claims in the registry
Bypass the outbound guard, the caps or a kill switch

charter.objective: Publish short videos that carry verifiable provenance and an honest disclosure, and confirm each one is live and unchanged

primary_metric.read_probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM video_queue WHERE status = 'published' AND verify_status = 'verified' AND published_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

guard_metrics.read_probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM video_queue WHERE status = 'removed' AND removed_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM video_queue WHERE status = 'published' AND verify_status = 'failed'

enable_gate: Turn on Short video publishing? It will publish short videos your organization made to the account you configure, up to 2 a day and 6 a week. Each video carries a provenance record (file hash, what made it, whether it is synthetic) and synthetic media always gets a visible disclosure label. Until it has earned trust, every video waits here as a card showing its title and description for you to approve. It will not clone a real person, buy views, hide that media is synthetic, or publish anything not backed by a fresh public claim. It costs only your channel's own fees. Turn it off any time with one action.
